glosses: to remove the bones of, to unbone, to debone

examples.text: Voordat je de kip roostert, moet je de kip ontbenen om het vlees gelijkmatig te garen.
examples.translation: Before roasting the chicken, you need to debone the chicken to cook the meat evenly.
examples.english: Before roasting the chicken, you need to debone the chicken to cook the meat evenly.
